purpose: Speed-oriented trade-off comparison for safe-pass dual-sided early exit.

definitions.false_pass_rate: error rate among samples that receive a label
definitions.pass_rate: fraction of samples that receive a reliable label
definitions.early_reject_rate: fraction of samples rejected before the final heavy stage
definitions.final_execution_rate: fraction of samples reaching the final heavy stage
definitions.avg_cost: normalized mean compute cost; HIGH-only is 1.0
